Since identical question of fact and law is involved in these Review Petitions, all these matters were heard analogously and are being decided by this common order.

By filing the aforementioned Writ Petitions, the writ petitioners were claiming the additional amount of compensation, solatium and interest 9 RP-432-2026 on solatium in light of the judgment passed by the Apex Court in the case of "Union of India and another Vs. Tarsem Singh and Others [(2019) 9 SCC 304]".
4 .

entities.text: Union of India and another Vs. Tarsem Singh and Others [(2019) 9 SCC 304]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
All the aforementioned Writ Petitions were disposed of vide abovementioned orders directing the respondent/National Highways Authority of India to pay additional compensation under Section 23(1-A), solatium under Section 23(2) and interest under Section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 in light of the judgement passed by the Apex Court in Tarsem Singh and Others (supra) within a period of six months from today.

5. The National Highways Authority of India filed a Review Petition (Civil) No.2528/2025 before the Apex Court for recalling of order dated 04.02.2025 passed in Miscellaneous Application No.1773/2021 (Tarsem Singh-II) [(2025) SCC Online SC 235].

sentences.text:
Vide order dated 25.03.2026 passed i n "National Highways Authority of India Vs. Tarsem Singh and Others [(2026) INSC 291]", the Apex Court has disposed of the Review Petition (Civil) No.2528/2025 with following directions :-
"D. CONCLUSION AND DIRECTIONS 14.

entities.text: National Highways Authority of India Vs. Tarsem Singh and Others [(2026) INSC 291]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances explained in the instant proceedings along with the various submissions placed on record andwith a view to balancing the equities regarding delay and the entitlements of the landowners, we issue the following directions:
(i) All landowners whose claims re: the quantum and/or components of compensation for their lands 10 RP-432-2026 acquired under the NH Act were alive on or after 28.03.2008, i.e., they were pending before one of the prescribed fora,
National Highway Authority Of India ... vs Lakhan Singh on 26 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186326422/
6 shall be entitled to seek addition of 'interest', 'solatium', and 'interest on the solatium'
to their compensation claim;

entities.text: National Highway Authority Of India ... vs Lakhan Singh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) In the cases where compensation claims are alive on the aforesaid date, but the landowner has claimed 'interest', 'solatium', and 'interest on solatium' after 28.03.2008, no interest on both components shall be payable for the period of delay.

Such landowner shall be entitled to 'interest'
and 'intereston solatium' only from the date on which such claims were raised; and (iii) If the claims of the landowners stood concluded prior to 28.03.2008, with no further appeal,
Writ Petition, Special Leave Petition, etc., then such landowners are not entitled to seek reopening,
review, or modification of the said decision for the purpose of claiming 'solatium' or 'interest'.
15.
The instant Review Petition, along with all pending applications, stand disposed of accordingly.

16. Delay is condoned and leave is granted in the tagged Special Leave Petitions, and while setting aside the impugned judgements of the High Courts, the matters are remanded to the concerned High Courts with a request to recalculate the 'interest', 'solatium', and 'interest on solatium'payable to the landowners.
Such computation shall be strictly in accordance with the directions issued hereinabove.
If the landowners are held to fall within the category of Paragraph 14(ii) then 11 RP-432-2026
the payment has to be made accordingly.
Similarly, in the cases of landowners who are covered by Paragraph 14(iii), no such benefit shall be granted.

17. As a matter of abundant caution, however, it is clarified that these directions do not entitle the NHAI or the Union of India to seek refund or recovery of the solatium or interest already paid to the landowners.

18. Ordered accordingly."
6.

In view of the above and with the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the present Review Petitions are disposed of and the orders passed in aforementioned Writ Petitions are modified to the extent that the claim i.e. additional compensation under Section 23(1-A), solatium under Section 23(2) and interest under Section 28 of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 be paid in view of the aforesaid conclusion drawn by the Apex Court in Review Petition (Civil) No.2528/2025.
7.
Accordingly, present Review Petitions are disposed of.
(VIVEK RUSIA)
